schema.text: When you walk or use a wheelchair, what do you do when streets, stops or paths are dirty or badly kept (litter, smells, broken glass)?

options.text: I notice it, but carry on as usual
It's unpleasant, but I still go that way
I avoid some stops or stretches
I stop using that route altogether

schema.help: Think about the parts of a journey you make along streets or pavements, on foot or using a wheelchair.

en.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: When you walk or use a wheelchair, what do you do when streets, stops or paths are dirty or badly kept (litter, smells, broken glass)?
en.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: I notice it, but carry on as usual
en.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: It's unpleasant, but I still go that way
en.#I avoid some stops or stretches: I avoid some stops or stretches
en.#I stop using that route altogether: I stop using that route altogether
en.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Think about the parts of a journey you make along streets or pavements, on foot or using a wheelchair.

it.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Quando ti sposti a piedi o in sedia a rotelle, cosa fai quando strade, fermate o percorsi sono sporchi o mal tenuti (rifiuti, cattivi odori, vetri rotti)?
it.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Me ne accorgo, ma vado avanti come sempre
it.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: È spiacevole, ma passo lo stesso da lì
it.#I avoid some stops or stretches: Evito alcune fermate o alcuni tratti
it.#I stop using that route altogether: Smetto del tutto di usare quel percorso
it.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Pensa ai tratti che percorri lungo la strada o sul marciapiede, a piedi o in carrozzina.

fr.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Lorsque vous marchez ou vous déplacez en fauteuil roulant, que faites-vous quand les rues, les arrêts ou les chemins sont sales ou mal entretenus (déchets, odeurs, verre brisé) ?
fr.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Je le remarque, mais je continue comme d'habitude
fr.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: C'est désagréable, mais je passe quand même par là
fr.#I avoid some stops or stretches: J'évite certains arrêts ou certains tronçons
fr.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Pensez aux parties du trajet que vous parcourez dans la rue ou sur le trottoir, à pied ou en fauteuil roulant.

de.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Was tun Sie beim Gehen oder Fahren im Rollstuhl, wenn Straßen, Haltestellen oder Wege schmutzig oder schlecht gepflegt sind (Müll, Gerüche, Glasscherben)?
de.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Ich merke es, mache aber wie gewohnt weiter
de.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: Es ist unangenehm, aber ich gehe trotzdem diesen Weg
de.#I avoid some stops or stretches: Ich meide manche Haltestellen oder Abschnitte
de.#I stop using that route altogether: Ich nutze diese Strecke gar nicht mehr
de.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Denken Sie an die Wegabschnitte, die Sie auf Straßen oder Gehwegen zu Fuß oder im Rollstuhl zurücklegen.

tr.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Yürürken veya tekerlekli sandalyeyle ilerlerken sokaklar, duraklar veya yollar kirli ya da bakımsız olduğunda (çöp, kokular, kırık cam) ne yaparsınız?
tr.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Fark ederim ama her zamanki gibi devam ederim
tr.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: Hoş değil ama yine de oradan giderim
tr.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Yolculuğunuzun sokaklarda veya kaldırımlarda yürüyerek ya da tekerlekli sandalyeyle yaptığınız bölümlerini düşünün.

fa.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: هنگام پیاده‌روی یا حرکت با ویلچر، وقتی خیابان‌ها، ایستگاه‌ها یا مسیرها کثیف یا نگهداری‌نشده‌اند (زباله، بوی بد، شیشه شکسته) چه می‌کنید؟
fa.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: متوجه می‌شوم، اما مثل همیشه ادامه می‌دهم
fa.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: ناخوشایند است، اما باز هم از آنجا می‌روم
fa.#I avoid some stops or stretches: از بعضی ایستگاه‌ها یا بخش‌هایی از مسیر دوری می‌کنم
fa.#I stop using that route altogether: دیگر اصلاً از آن مسیر استفاده نمی‌کنم
fa.#Think about the parts of a journey you: بخش‌هایی از سفر را در نظر بگیرید که در خیابان یا پیاده‌رو، پیاده یا با ویلچر طی می‌کنید.

hu.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Gyaloglás vagy kerekesszékes közlekedés közben mit tesz, ha az utcák, megállók vagy utak koszosak vagy elhanyagoltak (szemét, szagok, törött üveg)?
hu.#I stop using that route altogether: Egyáltalán nem használom többé azt az útvonalat
hu.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Gondoljon az utazás azon szakaszaira, amelyeket az utcán vagy a járdán gyalog vagy kerekesszékkel tesz meg.

ar.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: عند المشي أو التنقل بكرسي متحرك، ما تصرّفك عندما تكون الشوارع أو المحطات أو الممرات متسخة أو سيئة الصيانة (قمامة أو روائح أو زجاج مكسور)؟
ar.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: الأمر غير مريح، لكنني أمرّ من هناك مع ذلك
ar.#I stop using that route altogether: أتوقف تمامًا عن استخدام ذلك الطريق
ar.#Think about the parts of a journey you: فكّر في أجزاء الرحلة التي تقطعها في الشارع أو على الرصيف، مشيًا أو باستخدام كرسي متحرك.
